_comment: Import via Admin → Nests → Import Egg. Adjust docker image for your Windows Wings node.
name: Plutonium T6
author: CALDAS
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops II (Plutonium T6). Downloads via plutonium-updater; bin/games/storage/launcher na raiz do volume; dedicated.cfg em storage/t6.
startup: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=$PWD.Path; & (Join-Path $d 'bin\plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe') {{PLUTONIUM_MODE}} $d -dedicated +set key {{PLUTONIUM_KEY}} +set fs_game '{{FS_GAME}}' +exec '{{DEDICATED_CFG}}' +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_CLIENTS}} +map_rotate"

variables.name: Plutonium Updater URL
variables.description: URL do zip do plutonium-updater para Windows (GitHub releases).

variables.name: Dedicated Config
variables.description: Ficheiro cfg em storage\t6 (raiz do servidor). Use dedicated_zm.cfg para zombies.

variables.name: Slots Env Variable
variables.description: Variável de ambiente com o limite de slots no painel (apenas admin).

variables.name: Warn Slot Mismatch
variables.description: Exibir aviso quando a query reportar mais slots que o limite do painel (apenas admin).

variables.name: Mod Directory
variables.description: Pasta do mod (fs_game). Deixe vazio se não usar mod.
